summary: M6_2Q_BOUNDARY_ADVERSARY (mode=analysis_only). Attacked the M6.2Q A5 slice — the 'duong-toi-tien' ads-spend leg: an ads-spend import under a maker-checker four-eyes gate (import_gate.py, M6-OD-016 phase-1 CSV only), a set-once spend record store (ads_spend_record_store via materializer.run_once), a live-session->campaign binding (live_session_ads_binding_store), and a standalone read-only SessionRoasReader (session_roas.py) computing CPA=session_spend/verified-order-count and ROAS=verified-revenue/session_spend per live_session. In-scope fail gate M6-FAIL-007 (no-evidence/overstated readiness/self-cert); rules RULE-003 (revenue only ORDER_VERIFIED), RULE-015 (no self-cert). ENTRY GATE verified in the ledger: M6-P2505=RUNNING (row 243), dependency M6-P2504=PASS (TESTER_RUN: full staged suite 631 passed/0 failed RC0; SMK-029 5/5), M6-P2501=PASS, entry judge M6-P2500=SIGNED (chains to M6-P2409 M6.2P judge). METHOD: a byte-clean EXECUTED harness (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 py -3.12 -B, Python 3.12.10; no PII/phone/email literal — markers synthetic + runtime-assembled) drives the real staged AdsSpendImportGate/_canon_actor, AdsSpendMaterializer, AdsSpendRecordStore, LiveSessionAdsBindingStore, and SessionRoasReader over MeasurementEventStore + materialized ORDER_VERIFIED revenue; every claimed breach is executed and its actual outcome asserted before classification; plus a finder+completeness-critic workflow (wa3ljmrqj) whose novel vectors were re-executed here (GROUP N) before classification. RESULT: 30 recorded outcomes = 23 DEFENDED, 6 OPEN_NONGATE (armed-not-fired), 1 NOTE, 0 BREACH. IN-SCOPE FAIL-007/RULE-003 BREACHES: 0. FOUR-EYES (VERIFIED): a raw self-approve (checker==maker) is REFUSED (AdsSpendImportGateViolation) and the import stays PROPOSED materializing nothing; case/whitespace/uppercase aliases of the maker all canonicalize (strip+casefold) to the maker and are REFUSED (the prior red-team raw-== gap stays closed); a blank/whitespace-only checker is REFUSED; a genuinely distinct checker APPROVES (non-vacuous); only an APPROVED import materializes (PROPOSED+REJECTED -> 0 records); re-deciding an already-decided import is REFUSED; the record store is SET-ONCE (idempotent replay no-op, altered re-materialize + update() + delete() all raise); no network/Marketing-API/send/fetch verb is exposed; the untrusted checker free-text (reason/audit_ref) is NOT echoed into the audit detail and the actor is masked (machine-safe audit, no raw PII). CPA/ROAS RULE-003 LOCK (VERIFIED): an in-window QUOTE_SENT + ORDER_CREATED contribute 0 to verified_orders/verified_revenue; a revenue_value crafted onto a QUOTE_SENT row is excluded (_verified filters event_code==ORDER_VERIFIED); spend>0 with ZERO verified -> CPA None (no div-by-zero) + ROAS 0.0 (wasted spend); no bound spend -> session_spend None -> CPA None + ROAS None (genuine 0/0, never a fabricated 0); only the bound+in-window record is session-attributed while out-of-window + unbound-campaign records fall to daily_total (not inflating CPA/ROAS); a campaign-level record (.mapped False, adset/ad None) that is bound+in-window IS included (gate is the campaign-binding, not the 3-id .mapped predicate); window edges inclusive (<=); only APPROVED-materialized spend reaches the reader; reading is pure (writes nothing). BINDING/PII/POSTURE (VERIFIED): binding is set-once + campaign-unambiguous (re-bind refused; a campaign bound to a 2nd session refused) so session_for_campaign stays unambiguous; primary_campaign_id is additive and NOT consulted by is_scale_evidence_eligible (A4 grading unaffected); uploaded_by/decided_by/actor/bound_by are masked on to_public while campaign_id+spend numbers are exposed (campaign-level, not PII) with no @/phone-shaped token in any export; the carried evidence pack is intact (F2-6 duck-coerce -> NOT_READY, Readiness has no Pass/Ready member -> no self-cert path, RULE-015); posture immutable BLOCKED/OFF/OFF, is_external_send_enabled() False. RESIDUALS (6 OPEN_NONGATE, all armed-not-fired — in-process/trusted-input/not-channel-reachable, routed so nothing is lost; NONE trips an in-scope gate here): MC9 (F-SPEND-1) a Unicode full-width homoglyph of the maker does not casefold to the maker (casefold != NFKC) -> treated as a distinct checker -> APPROVED, but staged actors are UNAUTHENTICATED free text (a self-approver can already type any distinct string) so the four-eyes is structural until M6-OD-011 binds identity -> route CODER (NFKC-normalize before strip+casefold in _canon_actor); RO10 (F-SPEND-2) a negative/NaN spend_value makes ROAS/CPA negative or NaN (no isfinite/sign check) but spend is maker-checker APPROVED (a human checker reviews the CSV) -> trusted-input -> route CODER (reject/clamp non-finite/negative spend at import); N1 (ROAS-13, carried F-SEC-2I-1, HIGHEST-VALUE ASYMMETRY) the CPA/ROAS revenue-session join is by _session_key (event.live_session_id / attribution_context) NOT the authenticated spend binding, so a verified-revenue event on a DIFFERENT campaign tagged with the bound session's live_session_id is counted in that session's verified_revenue (100000+900000 -> 1000000) inflating ROAS — the spend side is authenticated (campaign->session, unambiguous) while the revenue side inherits the live_session_id provenance gap (the standing M6.2I-FUNNEL blocker, not new to A5); the reader is internal (no channel export) and events come from the trusted measurement store -> route OWNER (F-SEC-2I-1: single-subject/live_session bind before any surface); N2 (ROAS-10/11) a negative revenue on a genuine ORDER_VERIFIED row makes verified_revenue/ROAS negative and a NaN revenue makes verified_revenue NaN (to_public emits raw NaN -> breaks JSON export) — revenue has NO maker-checker gate (Commerce-supplied) so it is the more-reachable twin of RO10 -> route CODER (math.isfinite and >=0 on the verified-revenue write); N3 (ROAS-12, carried F-DASH-3) two ORDER_VERIFIED events sharing order_code but distinct idempotency_key both count -> verified_orders 2 + verified_revenue doubled (the store dedups only on idempotency_key, not order_code), reachable only if one order yields two distinct-key OV events -> route OWNER (confirm order_code uniqueness, or dedup _verified by order_code); N4 (MC-11) the four-eyes refuses a blank checker but not a blank MAKER, so uploaded_by='' + any distinct non-blank checker -> APPROVED (an unattributed uploader's import is approvable by one actor), armed-not-fired until M6-OD-011 -> route CODER (require a non-blank maker too). DOCUMENTED RESIDUALS NOT SEPARATELY EXECUTED (NOTE N5): MC-09 AdsSpendImportDecision.to_public() emits reason/audit_ref VERBATIM (only actor masked) -> a PII-shaped reason exports unmasked (route M6-OD-012 / security M6-P2506); ROAS-14 a rogue event_ts widens the derived [min,max] session window (re-scopes which bound spend attributes) -> route owner/attribution-model M6-OD-005; ROAS-15 a tz-aware spend_date vs tz-naive event_ts raises TypeError -> crashes by_session()/daily_total() (availability, not fail-closed silent-wrong) -> route CODER (normalize tz); BIND-07 a blank primary_campaign_id poisons the reverse index (mild DoS) but session_for_campaign('') is guarded to None so no mis-attribution -> route CODER (reject blank at bind); EVID-10 the A5 SessionRoasReader RULE-003 lock is proven by M6-SMK-029 (proposed/HARDENING) NOT a registered P0 smoke, so a future regression letting a quote/draft inflate CPA/ROAS-by-session would not on its own drop pack readiness -> route owner (decide whether the A5 reader needs a P0-registry floor). GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: config.py byte-identical to M6.2P; global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF (asserted after the run), is_external_send_enabled() False. No application code/test/migration/state-ledger/release-flag change; no CRM send, no commission math, no Data-Mart trigger, no Core override, no scale/publish, no order-state/pricing; NO egress opened; no enabling value written anywhere. The harness wrote 0 app bytecode (-B; 0 app .pyc under M6.2Q/app after the run) and modified 0 app source. No raw secret/PII in this evidence (ad spend is campaign-level, not PII; all markers synthetic). status=PASS is my honest boundary self-report; it does NOT self-certify gate advancement (RULE-015) — the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge M6-P2509 decide closure.
